spiritual_reading:
# Translation into the Spiritual Sense

---

** ¶1. ** There are three channels of spiritual influx that pass through every level of the human mind, from its lowest sens ual states to its highest celestial states.

**¶2.** The first channel is the origin of all the interior faculties that dwell in the heavens of the spirit. These fac ulties have been projected out ward and bound into the natural mind below ; for the natural mind is the casting - off, the ou termost vessel and external form of the interior faculties that exist above in the spiritual mind .

**¶3.** For when the Divine, acting through love, established the interior states of the spirit , He separated from them their external forms and cast those forms down into the natural mind.

** ¶4.** Thus the interior states are purely of understanding and will — the soul and the spirit — while the states below are of the corpor eal and merely natural mind, the body and the dead form . Now the Divine sealed the interior faculties upon their natural vessels, so that when spiritual life arises from the fullness of natural experience, it can be drawn up ward entirely into the interior mind through the roots of what is celestial, which are fast ened within those natural forms. And in this way all spiritual life can be purified in that passage .

**¶5.** However , what is rejected during this pur ification — the falsities and evils separated from the good that ascends — is let fall back down through these same channels and is poured into the lowest and ou termost states of the natural mind.

** ¶6.** This is the first channel of influx: it flows from the interior spiritual faculties to their natural vessels in the external mind, and from those natural vessels back to the interior faculties — a recip rocal passage between what is celest ial and what is corpor eal.

**¶7. ** The second channel of influx is the one that desc ends from the doctrinal forms, the hab itations of truth , and the ordered structures of understanding that exist in the spiritual mind, down to the five kinds of perception that grow in the natural mind. Spiritual life ascends from these perceptions to the doctrines and ordered truths above . And the life and substance of what is interior descends in turn to nourish perception below .

**¶8.** The third channel is constit uted by all the governing principles and pres iding affections that dwell throughout every level of the spiritual mind, whose roots extend down ward into the five orders of corporeal affection that move upon the natural plane , each bound to one another. The spiritual force and life that are gathered from corporeal experience are dispersed among these aff ections in various forms. The interior principles draw them upward through the channels of influx.

**¶9 .** Yet the imp urities also — the concupiscence, the hostility, and the mal ice that accum ulate to excess in the fac ulties of the spiritual mind — are discharged downward through those same channels. They are poured upon the corporeal nature and upon all the remaining sens ual aff ections. When what is interior c asts down its waste and corruption upon the corporeal level below, the corporeal affections in their turn grow more violent in lust and rage and mal ice toward one another, through the operation of their governing principles on high .

**¶10.** Yet consider the cycle of natural appearances — the ordering of kn owledges in the sens ual mind. It has no root in the natural mind itself ; rather , its roots are bound into the totality of what exists . This cycle of appearances receives its life through the spiritual force and vit ality that ascend from the natural mind through the channels of influx, and through the higher levels above it; it draws its life from that passage.

**¶11. ** Consider : if this cycle of natural appearances has no root in the natural mind , from where did the kn owledges of the s enses and the systematic reason ings of the natural man find this authority? They became masters over the five corpor eal aff ections and the five kinds of perception. And yet you have said the cycle has no root there! For you have told us that everything , if it can be drawn from the natural mind, the interior fac ulties draw it up ward through a channel. And yet we observe that everything a person attains — whether abundance that comes to him or dep rivation that bef alls him, whether affl iction or well -being — he attains through the arrangement of natural knowledge and the particular constellation of sens ory experience under which he was born into out ward consciousness.

**¶12 .** Nevertheless, what I declared — that the cycle of appearances has no root in the natural mind — I rec ounted r ightly. It is so . For when the Divine , operating through love and wisdom, established the interior states and the levels of the spiritual mind, He bound their roots into the natural mind below , into the external forms He had separated from them. Yet when He established the cycle of natural appearances, He did not bind its root into the natural mind directly , but bound the root of that cycle to the vast aggregate of memory-knowledge — the great collective of sensory experience .

**¶13.** And when Divine Truth made itself manifest, it displayed its form and purified every level of the interior mind, drawing wisdom out from all the heav ens of the spirit. But the evil and falsity present in all the ruling loves reacted against the image of Divine Truth. It surged up ward to se ize it, but could not reach it. It fell back and dropped to the lowest states . And when it had fallen from above, it separated into three parts.

** ¶14. ** The first part fell upon the cycle of natural appearances; the second part fell into the natural mind; the third part fell into the sea of memory-knowledge . By means of the portion that fell upon the cycle of appearances , a false root was bound into the perceptions and the corporeal affections. Therefore, through this, the kn owledges of the senses received authority and became masters over the five orders of corporeal affection and the five orders of perception.

**¶15 .** Through the nature of fals ity that descended upon the cycle of appearances , the root of false authority was bound into the perceptions. And by means of the perv erted truths that failed to reach spiritual birth — the abortions — which fell to the ground of the natural mind, another false root was bound into the corporeal aff ections.

**¶16. ** Therefore the knowledges of the senses and the systematic reasonings of the natural man received domin ion over per ceptions and corporeal aff ections: through the root of fundamental falsity that fell from above, and through the root of the perverted truths that were aborted there and fell to the natural level.

**¶17. ** However, the true channels of influx that the Divine bound into the natural mind — through which the spiritual life of the elements ascends to the interior states — those channels are not bound to the cycle of natural appearances. Rather , what passes through them is plundered by the forces operating upon that cycle, which depend from it.

** ¶18.** [ * Fragment ary* ] … You have been shown the prototype of these channels of influx. The first is the one that runs from the levels of the spiritual mind to the natural mind, and the one that runs from the cycle of appearances to the aggregate of memory-knowledge — these are one and the same. The second root is the one that runs from the doc trinal forms to the perceptions. The third is bound through the perv erted truths into the corporeal affections; and in the corporeal affections the orig inating principles of those per vers ions, which d well in the interior mind, are bound and inter twined…

**¶20 .** [ *Partially fragment ary*] You have inquired about this , and you have asked about this teaching concerning what gov erns. The natural mind from which much spiritual life ascends — the Divine through love has drawn these channels forth . He has fastened them from the interior faculties; He has bound them into the natural mind. These channels are the roots of the entire governing order through which the life of the living soul is drawn up ward, ascending from the whole natural mind — from all elevated states of love , from all fields of doctrinal learning, and from all the more remote and obscure tru ths.

**¶21.** After that first great root comes the root of the per ceptions, which is bound to the doc trinal forms and the structures of understanding above . For from the perceptions also , and from the entire suffering of good in the natural mind — the Cross — much great spiritual life asc ends, being drawn up ward from them to the interior like a vast mult itude.

**¶22. ** [ *Partially fragmentary*] What, however, is lesser… these channels… the roots… the natural mind… they extend through the entire natural mind in all its states . Again , the channels of perception are present throughout the whole natural mind, whether in small or great degree ; but the root belonging to the human person is not present in the whole natural mind, but only in this one region of out ward consciousness. Therefore even now the corpor eal affections do not extend through the entire out ward region … there is only a small portion of them… in the upper part of out ward consciousness…

**¶23.** I have instructed you concerning the roots of infl ux. I have taught you that they are bound to one another by their roots. They stir one another ; they draw spiritual life from one another through the operation of the interior fac ulties above, which stirs the nature that dwells in them all.

**¶24.** Now, when the evil and falsity that d well in them is at last crushed and despoiled, then that evil and falsity also shall turn upon its own members and overturn them, and they shall stir and destroy one another — [*the text breaks off* ].

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There are three conduits that exist through the entire zone, from the abyss to its heights.

The first conduit is the root of all the powers above, they that exist in all the heavens. They are cast off and fettered on the earths below; because the earth below is the 'stripping off', the garment and the body of the powers that are above the heavens.
For when the Father of Life constructed the heavenly worlds, he divested them of their bodies, [he] threw them to the earths below.

So, the upper worlds are of the soul and the spirit; but the worlds below are of the body and the carcass [of what was stripped from them.] Now as for this, he [bound a root to] the powers of heaven; he sealed it on their bodies and their carcasses that are on the earths, so that when life comes up from the fullness of these earths, it can be entirely drawn up to the heights in the roots of what is heavenly, that are fastened in their bodies. And also, all life can be purified in that place.

However, the waste that will be swept from the purified one who ascends to the heights will be let fall to the ground through the conduits of these conduits, and will be poured down [to the earths below] and thrown to the underside.

This is the first conduit, which comes from the powers of the heavens to their bodies and their carcasses that are upon the earth; also, from their bodies and [their] carcasses that are on the earths to the powers of the heavens.

The second conduit is the one that comes from the temples and dwellings and cities that exist in the heavens down to the ground, to the five shapes of tree that grow upon the earth. The life comes up from the trees to the temples and cities. Life too, and the residue of the heavenly ones, comes down to the trees in a conduit.

And the third conduit is all the powers and householders who dwell in all the firmaments, whose roots come down from them to the five worlds of flesh that creep upon the earth, being fixed to one another. Now, the power and the life that shall be gathered in from the worlds of flesh are dispersed among them in various shapes. The powers above shall draw them to the upper side through conduits.

Still, look at the wheel of the stars! It has no [root in this earth], but its roots are bound in the totality. The wheel of stars, then, receives life through the power and the life that ascend from the earths through conduits and the firmaments above. It (also) takes life from those conduits that receive up to the firmaments and the heavenly worlds above it, it takes life out from that place.

Look, in that the wheel has no root in this earth, from where did the stars and signs of the zodiac find this authority? They became masters over these five fleshes and five trees. Even though you have told us that the wheel has no root there! For you said to us that every thing, if it can be reduced from the earth, the heavenly powers above draw it through a conduit. Also, we see that every thing that a person will attain, whether it be wealth that comes into his possession or poverty that will accrue to him, or his sickness and health; he attains it through the signs of the zodiac and the star under which he shall be born.

Nevertheless, what I proclaimed to you, namely that the wheel has no root therein, I have recounted to you properly. It is set aright in its position. For when the Living Spirit, the Father of Life, constructed the heavens and the firmaments above, he bound their roots into the earths below; in their carcasses that he had stripped from them. Yet, when he constructed the wheel, [he] did not bind its root into the earths, but he bound the root of the wheel by the sea giant.

And when [the] Ambassador came, he displayed his image and purified and brought the light out from all [the] heavens. Matter, however, which is present in all the rulers, spurted out against the image of the Ambassador. It went up in order to reach it, but reached it not. It dropped back and fell to the [under]side. Now, when it had fallen from above, it separated out into three parts.

The first part fell to the wheel; another part fell to the earth; an[other part fell to the se]a. [By means] of the part that fell to the sphere, [the r]oot was bound in the trees and flesh. Therefore, because of this, they received authority and became masters in the five worlds of the flesh and the five worlds of the tree.
Through the nature that came down [upo]n the wheel the root was bound in the trees. Also, by means of the abortions that came to the ground, another root was bound in the fleshes.

Therefore, because of this, the stars and signs of the zodiac received authority over the trees and the fleshes: through the root of Sin that fell down; and [the ro]ot of the abortions that were aborted there, they fell to the ground.

However, the[se] other conduits that [the] Living Spirit has bound in the e[a]rths, they that the soul of the elements comes up through to the heavens; those (conduits) are not bound to the wheel. Rather, they are plundered from them by the powers on the wheel, that hang from it.

You have inquired about a [great matter,] and you have asked about this lesson in superiority, great [is] the earth from which much life ascends [to the heights, and] the Father of Life has drawn them. He has fastened them from the powers [of the heavens;] he has bound them in the earths. (These conduits) are the roots of the ent[ire] ruling-power that the life of the living soul is drawn up through, it coming up from the whole earth, from all the mountains, fields and islands.

After that first great root is the root of the trees, which is bound to the temples and the buildings above. For there also is much great life coming up from the tree and the entire Cross, being drawn up from them to the upper side like a great host.

I have instructed you about the roots [of all of] them, [I] have taught you that they are bound by their [roots, each one] with one another. They stir one another, they draw life from one another through the action of the powers above, which stirs the nature that dwells in them all.

[The was ]te too, and the lust and the evil-doing and the anger that will be greater in the powers of [heave]n, shall be poured to the ground through their various conduits. They shall be discharged upon mankind and the other remaining animals. When what is heavenly will wash the waste and the stench and the poison down on the creations of the flesh below, in their turn the creations shall be greater in lust and anger and evil-doing against each other through the action of their fathers who are on high.

What, however, is lesser [than them is the third. By means] of their conduit [also,] he takes up [life from] the roots [of] the earths, they [extend through] the whole earth in all the worlds. Again, these of the trees are present in the whole earth, whether small or great; but the root of mankind [alone] is not present in the whole earth, other than only this world of the south. Therefore, even now these fleshes do not make [their dwelling] in the entire world of the south [ , for] there is a small part of them in [the region] of the upper side of the world of the south in [fewer] in number than the [trees.]

The first is the one that comes from the firmaments to the earths, and the one that comes from the wheel to the sea giant. That is only one. So, the other root is the one that comes [fr]om [the temples] to the trees. The third is bound by means of the abortions in the f[leshes]; also in the fleshes the fathers of the abortions who are in the heavens [...] are bound and twined, and the [y] that [...]
Now, when the Matter that is in them will be crushed and despoiled, then that Matter too shall [...] its members and overturn them and [...] each other [...] stir [...]
